title: The Rattleknife's First Treasure
rumor: The Rattleknife's First Treasure. Goblin bandits have long passed the name Kreech Redcap from one chief to another. According to a popular tale, the original Redcap hid a fortune somewhere in the forest, leaving a series of ridiculous riddles that only another goblin would understand. Every new bearer of the name supposedly searches for the treasure, though none has publicly claimed to find it.
first_lead: Spindle Vex is rumored to possess one of the original riddles, or at least a convincing forgery.
